{{Quote|You see, I'm a chef, and I'm trying to make a new meat stew. I plan on serving it to Jabba the Hutt himself. What I need is a new kind of meat...meat that you can't get anywhere else.|Fiask Nidori, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GFS" />}}
'''Fiask Nidori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:GFS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he visited [[Station Gamma]], an [[Asteroid base|asteroid-carved space station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] in order to find a new kind of meat. Nidori tasked several individuals to hunt [[Rat/Legends|rats]] in the station and collect their meat. However, they were quite unsuccessful due to the presence of a tribe of violent [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], the [[Rak'qua]], in the station. Finally, a spacer managed to kill six rats and provided the meat to Nidori. The Aqualish chef appreciated the taste and started the preparation of a meat stew that could impress the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="SWG:GFS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fiask Nidori appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GFS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Fiask Nidori was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
